'''Bey Savaros''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] and the father of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Kajin Savaros]]. When an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] visited their world, Bey and his [[Kajin Savaros's mother|wife]] decided to send their son to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], hoping someone from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] would take him in and train him.<ref name="CN3" />
